answer: Voting influence is \((t/2^{k-1})^2\), with \(t\) continuous attested service and \(k\) live heads. ivory stores the sole \(t\) per owner; quartz advances it once per epoch after accepted service, and canyon merges heads through audited beneficial-ownership records, not wallets. Matching an honest head’s weight at \(t=T\) costs a debut \(T\) epochs, but ten heads cost \(512T\) serial attested epochs; head ten adds \(256T\). Clones cannot tick in parallel or split the clock, while another owner starts at \(k=1\).
